grain: One calendar year per row, sorted ascending, unique key year.
source: Frozen supplied 2022_HiMCM_Data.xlsx; no web values admitted.

co2_ppm.meaning: Mauna Loa annual CO2 mean, not March or global spatial mean

temp_anomaly_c.meaning: Global annual land-ocean index relative to 1951-1980

normalization: CSV preserves supplied hundredths. Raw reader repr and normalization delta are retained per source row. Negative and zero anomalies are valid. No imputation, outlier removal, scaling or baseline shift.
checks: ingestion-checks-r01.json records source identity, coverage and normalization checks; source-values-r01.json preserves cell-level provenance.
